name: Rafael Augusto Almeida Costa
title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
summary: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer with 12+ years of experience designing, integrating, and validating firmware and hardware for industrial, automotive, and IoT products. Strong background in real-time systems, low-power embedded design, communication protocols, and cross-functional delivery from prototype to production.

bullets: Led embedded firmware development for connected sensor modules, reducing release defects by 38% over three product cycles.
Defined board bring-up and validation procedures for 6+ hardware revisions, cutting prototype debug time by 30%.
Coordinated with hardware, test, and manufacturing teams to launch 4 production programs on schedule.
Improved boot and communication stack performance by 22% through task optimization and protocol tuning.
Architected firmware for industrial control devices using FreeRTOS and C++, supporting over 50,000 deployed units.
Standardized driver and middleware layers across product lines, reducing code duplication by 45%.
Implemented CAN and Modbus integration features that expanded interoperability with legacy equipment.
Mentored a team of 5 engineers and established code review and regression testing practices.
Developed and validated embedded control software for avionics support equipment, meeting strict traceability requirements.
Built automated hardware-in-the-loop test setups that increased test coverage by 28%.
Worked on real-time communication and fault-handling logic, improving system resilience during stress testing.
Supported certification documentation and design reviews across engineering and quality teams.
Created low-level firmware for consumer electronics products, including peripheral drivers and startup code.
Reduced firmware memory footprint by 18% through stack optimization and module refactoring.
Supported PCB bring-up, signal debugging, and production testing for multiple high-volume releases.
